settings.title: Settings
settings.draft_help: Settings are saved and can be reloaded. This development package cannot initialize C1 with the shared identity provider or verify its recovery state yet. C1 remains stopped and its application route is not published; saving a draft does not request a certificate.
settings.issuer_ca_help: Leave blank to preserve the saved CA bundle. TLS verification stays enabled.
settings.ca_present: A private issuer CA bundle is saved.
settings.enrollment_pending: Initial administrator enrollment will use a separate verified setup flow when the upstream contract is available.
settings.draft_saved: Deployment draft saved. Production setup remains blocked.
settings.session_max_before_idle: Maximum session duration must be at least the idle duration.
settings.provider_unavailable: The selected identity provider is unavailable.
settings.domain_unavailable: The selected user domain is unavailable.
settings.invalid_issuer: The provider does not advertise a valid HTTPS issuer.
settings.invalid_ca: The issuer CA must be a valid PEM certificate bundle.

integration.status_help: Backend service health does not mean C1 setup is complete. Authentication, initialization and recovery await verified upstream support.

administration.title: Administration
administration.pending: C1 is unavailable until authentication and initial-administrator enrollment are verified.
administration.help: When setup is ready, this page will open the existing C1 Explorer in a separate browser tab. NS8 administrator access does not grant C1 knowledge permissions.
